00-aujourdhui: Today, we're learning the letter n.
02-regarde: Watch how we write the n.
03-depart: We start on the green dot. We make a crook turned to the LEFT, like a pilgrim's staff. We come straight down, then we go back UP ON THE SAME LINE, without lifting the pencil. We make a big bridge, we come down, and we finish with a little curve resting on the line.
04-encore: One more time, a little faster.
05-cherchons: Now, let's find words that begin with n.
10-pareil: Did you hear? They all begin the same way.
11-relance: Find a word that begins with n.
